o.text: A derivation from Proto-Turkic *āt- (“step; to step”) + -ım. Cognate with Turkish adım, Bashkir аҙым (aðım), Chuvash утӑм (ut̬ăm) etc.
Borrowed from Arabic صَنَائِع (ṣanāʔiʕ), plural of Arabic صِنَاعَة (ṣināʕa).
Borrowed from Russian гидроакустика (gidroakustika). By surface analysis, hidro- + akustika.
